items.text: Mandragora Studio & tinyBuild

Here's the update you’ve all been waiting for! At the Housewarming party, it didn't seem to go just as planned, so it's time to win back some trust and build more of a relationship with your fellow rooftop friends!

We have a new roof - the Entertainment Zone! Hotel guests would swim, exercise, sing, dance, and watch movies. We've even added new themed items to dismantle. Keep exploring to find a new cosmetic item 👀
The long-awaited continuation of the main storyline is here but where could we go after the housewarming party?
Now we have the answer for you. Although the story is not yet finished we do have some surprises waiting to keep you guessing.

Develop relationships with your friends on the rooftop! After such a housewarming, it’s only natural that you'd want to cheer them up. As you develop relationships, you can give them gifts that you find on expeditions, play mini-games, and complete daily tasks! With each relationship level, new rewards will unlock for you.
The relationship system is our main focus for this update. We hope you will find it as exciting and fun to befriend a fridge as we did implementing it!

Have you wondered why you communicate through the Smart Tower? We have an answer: now you can. Every day, you will discover lost messages from the residents of flooded Cosmopolis every day. Some will even talk back like the Game Master! More characters will be communicating in the future, so check back often.
In this update, we’ve prepared a whole series of new modules. Starting with the long-awaited tool upgrades. Spend as little time as possible dismantling trash!
Want to know the weather forecast? Install the weather forecast module.
Do your minions often run out of power? Increase their battery life! Speaking of our little helpers:

Speaking of our little robot minions, with every update, we give these cuties a significant dose of attention. We constantly work to improve the minion AI to make them smarter along with some new added features too:
We have some new roles: The water carrier, aqua genius, and repairman. These minions will water the flower beds, refill the sprinklers, and repair your buildings.
We’ve improved minion behavior and added statuses and custom routes.
All minions, not just gatherers, can search for and collect resources from the ground. (It wasn't easy, but we finally did it!)
Idle minions will no longer waste energy.

Last but not least, Minions will now complete tasks to the end! Sometimes, the goal is so far that the battery almost dies. Don’t worry - other minions have volunteered to help to the end and then go back to recharge.

notes.title: And a Few More Small Changes

items.text: We redesigned the floor patches to look more plastic. Many players suggested they should be made of planks, but we have other ideas. And, trust us, carrying hundreds of planks for all the patches would be extremely tiring.
New resource - reactor.
There are three levels of repair kits with new models and animations. Repair minions also use them – be sure to check them out!
The water storage barrel has become an essential element of gameplay. We have moved it to the regular storage category. We will return everything to those who managed to buy it with coupons.
That's all for today, future-dwellers! Follow I Am Future to stay updated.

items.text: Mandragora Studio & tinyBuild
The new rooftop is available after completing the New Home quest. Exploring this rooftop will reveal the story of Muscle Claus, "the strongest" man in Cosmopolis.

Two structures that expand the game's electrical system. The solar generator operates without fuel but won't work at night or in dark weather. The battery helps preserve energy in the electrical grid, allowing for long-lasting autonomy. Together, they create a powerful grid that doesn't even need fuel.
Level 3 drill and level 3 injector. These will help disassemble everything on the rooftop.
The automatic sprinkler and pump have been upgraded to level 3, and the water supply and irrigation system have received their long-awaited improvements.

A week cycle has been added to the game. It diversifies the expedition system, with many points of interest now only open on certain days of the week. Conversely, the rewards at these points have been increased. Also, traders do not work on certain days of the week. But where do they go? They replenish their inventory. Track the days when traders and points of interest are available in the new character menu tab - the Calendar.

Another feature introduced to diversify the world of I Am Future is the weather cycle. Currently, overcast and rainy weather has been created. Each affects the rooftop. Mushrooms even grow during overcast weather. In rainy weather, you don't need to water the plants; the barrels automatically fill with fresh water. Remember to pour the saltwater first, as they don't mix well. However, rainy weather is considered dark for the solar generator and won't charge.
There is a new device to disassemble, but we suggest you find it yourself. Now, all devices that you disassemble may contain an unexpected find.

Remember how often you wrote that electrical grids from different rooftops couldn't be connected? Now they can! We've added a system of electrical poles on all ladders and the bridge. You just need to install them.

notes.title: A chest in the fishing area 🎁

items.text: Since everyone is tired of fishing trips, when you leave your rod at home, store it in the meta-network of chests and retrieve it even in the fishing zone. By the way, you can now build a special chest there. To avoid disassembling all household appliances on-site, they can now be lifted by an elevator.

The second level of the fishing rod really expands the list of catches, which can negatively impact when you need to catch the most basic thing - mollusks. A special recipe at the workbench will create a bait that exclusively catches mollusks.
New rooftop - new plants. They expand the farming and cooking systems. Try 7 new recipes in our menu before the rest!
The theme of the new rooftop is sports, so we had to add a sports suit.
You can now craft as many buckets as you want at the workbench. They are more convenient to use than bottles.

notes.title: A new navigation system for minions 🤖

items.text: This is a big step towards making them the most helpful helpers. The minion navigation system is a huge task, and, of course, it is not perfect yet, but it is now working much faster and making fewer mistakes. We will also give it special attention in a future update!

We placed hints throughout all the systems in the game on the loading screen so they are no longer empty. They were selected based on your feedback, which we truly appreciate! One of the frequent issues not explained in the game is where Agatha's shop is located. Now, it is highlighted on the map of expeditions, even at the first level of the smart tower.
